data: What is the time required for the blue line of the RNTN model to reach 93% accuracy?

The blue line represents the Iterative implementation of the RNTN model. By examining the graph, we can see that the blue line reaches the 93% accuracy mark around 7783 seconds. Therefore, the time required for the blue line of the RNTN model to reach 93% accuracy is approximately 7783 seconds.
